scientific_integrity: The result is a new, self-contained one-step distributional statement; the established one-step expected-residual identity is explicitly credited. Mathematical convex-order bounds follow from an analytic conditional-expectation coupling and attainability proof, not from numerical sampling. Novelty is provisional pending independent examination and possible equivalent stochastic-order formulations.
scientific_limitations: One exact diagonal-proportional pivot of a nonzero finite-dimensional real symmetric or complex Hermitian PSD matrix only. Comparisons vary the complete orthogonal or unitary coordinate basis at fixed spectrum; not a cheap preconditioner, not a multi-step convergence statement, not a first-order stochastic dominance theorem.
title: Sharp convex-order endpoints for one-pivot randomly pivoted Cholesky
